map.为什么系统持续比单灯短？: Why is the system duration shorter than a single lamp's?
map.系统总功率是各灯具之和，电池能量固定时总功率越大续航越短；11.5 h 是整系统: The system total power is the sum of all luminaires, and with fixed battery energy the greater the total power the shorter the duration; 11.5 h is the total duration with the whole system lit simultaneously.
map.80% 放电效率怎么理解？: How to understand the 80% discharge efficiency?
